thread:
maria_ae: Heads-up — running a Velora POC this morning, they're hitting intermittent 429s and a few auth errors. They're also waiting on answers for the security questionnaire and asked about Dedicated vs Private pricing. Need handoff + triage.

bryan_se: On it. Can you DM the exact request pattern? sample prompts / concurrency?

maria_ae: They're replaying a sitemap summarization job, ~120 reqs/min, bursty: short prompts (<=128 tokens). Using hosted API with api key via our SDK. They hit first 429 around 14:12 UTC.

olga_infra: Can I get the raw logs? tenant id / client id?

maria_ae: client_id=velora-poc, tenant=velora-inc. Posting the snippet they pasted: ```
[2026-03-20T14:12:03Z] 429 GET /v1/generate?model=redwood-large - tokens=0 - client_id=velora-poc
{"error":"quota_exceeded","detail":"rate limit exceeded"}
```

kevin_sre: That looks like a per-API-key token throttle, not backend OOM. Two things: (1) confirm they didn't hit per-minute token cap; (2) check routing fallback history. I'll tail the rate limiter now.

deploy-bot: Autoscaler: spawned 2 additional serving pods for model redwood-large in us-west-2 at 2026-03-20T14:15:02Z.

bryan_se: @velora, did you have client-side retries/backoff? Also did you set any concurrency limits on your worker pool?

maria_ae: Customer says they have exponential backoff but very aggressive concurrency when they replay. They can slow down, but want platform to handle baseline spikes.

olga_infra: I pulled their request headers. They're sending continuous 8 concurrent streams per host, which multiplied across their 15 hosts equals ~120 concurrent. For hosted plan default we have soft burst limits that can trigger 429s here. There's an option to request burst quota or shift to Dedicated.

sam_csm: I'll coordinate quota request and security Q answers. Maria — we need the security questionnaire PDF from them and their SOC2 contact. Also they asked about data retention/deletion for PII.

maria_ae: Got it — I'll collect the questionnaire and contact. They also asked: "If we go Dedicated for POC, what's the shortest lead time and incremental cost?"

bryan_se: For Dedicated POC: typical cold lead 7–10 days for provisioning in us-west-2, we can do a short-term trial (30 days) with a temporary uplift ~+40% on compute pricing compared to hosted per-token. If they need on-prem Private, that's a separate procurement and can take 4–6 weeks.

kevin_sre: For immediate mitigation we can: (A) grant a temporary soft-burst increase for their tenant for 24–48h, (B) enable per-client queuing to smooth spikes, (C) advise them to throttle to 60 reqs/min while we monitor. Option A requires sign-off from infra lead.

olga_infra: I can approve a 24h soft-burst from infra side. Doing it now — pushing config change.

deploy-bot: RateLimitConfig update: tenant=velora-poc, max_burst_tokens +200k, window=24h applied at 2026-03-20T14:20:09Z.

maria_ae: Thanks. Communicating to Velora: we enabled a temporary burst and recommend they apply client-side backoff. Also asked to share security contacts.

velora_repr (via maria_ae): They confirmed they'll throttle to 70 reqs/min and send over the security questionnaire by EOD. Also asked if logging can redact PII — they need a written note.

bryan_se: We can provide an official note: hosted logs redact user-provided prompt content by default for PII patterns; for stronger guarantees use Dedicated/Private with customer-managed KMS. I'll draft the note and attach.

sam_csm: Action items: (1) maria to collect questionnaire + SOC2 contact (due EOD), (2) bryan to send redaction note + Dedicated pricing sheet (by 17:00 PST), (3) olga/kevin monitor metrics for 24h and report RCA if 429s persist.

maria_ae: I'll get the questionnaire and confirm SLA expectations.

kevin_sre: Monitoring: I'm watching 429 rate over last 10m — it's down after burst, CPU on redwood-large nodes normalized. If it spikes again I'll open incident in #incidents and ping infra oncall.

olga_infra: Also flagged security question about data deletion — for hosted we can confirm deletion within 90 days after tenant termination; Dedicated/Private can do custom retention via config. I'll include that detail in the notes.

bryan_se: FYI Velora asked about a canary rollout for a model variant with lower latency. We can set up a 10% traffic split on Dedicated or via smart routing on hosted for canary. Will propose in the pricing/plan doc.

maria_ae: Thanks team — I'll update the customer thread and cc the questionnaire when it arrives. If anything changes ping here. :thumbsup:

kevin_sre: Marking this thread monitored. Will update if any anomalies. :eyes:
